name: Hiram College
tuition_note: Private college, single published rate used as in_state_tuition. Figures are 2024-25 tuition & fees ($27,600) and combined on-campus food & housing ($11,850) from the federal College Navigator/IPEDS record for Hiram College, Hiram OH (nces.ed.gov/collegenavigator id=203128). Hiram's own tuition-fees page (hiram.edu/admissions-aid/tuition-fees/) returned HTTP 403/empty to automated fetch, so the authoritative federal IPEDS data was used. IPEDS reports room and board only as a combined figure, so housing_basis is room + board.
